effects.actual_behavior: Mod constructs two specs, but LegendaryMonsters registers ONLY MOB_CONFIG_SPEC as COMMON type. Old CommonConfig fields have no packaged reads outside construction; unregistered definitions are not current gameplay defaults. Exact table preserves builder paths/key spelling, native fields, types/default/ranges and all packaged consumer identities; zero-read MobConfig fields remain unused. Comments are not behavior. False defaults: Cloudprojectile, AllowWitheredAbominationStun, TheObliteratorAnnihilationEffect; ordinary other declared booleans true. MiniBoss cap21, Cloud18, Paladin21, Obliterator20; adaptation integer1, anti-airborne integer4, clone HP7, portal HP5, portal explosion HP3. All numeric default/range bindings are observation only, not scaling policy. Native consumers in independently reviewed methods determine actual formulas/dispatch/eligibility; copied field labels and config paths do not establish active attacks. Flameborn Warrior health field uses damage label and damage field health label; field consumer identity determines effect. Music multiplier permits0 and is divisor in client volume expression; no combat effect inferred. Multipliers permit0..1000 (FKnight0..100), live server state overrides external config values; pinned default is not assumed loaded value.

effects.actual_behavior: All71 compressed native templates have DataVersion3465 and are captured without ordinary-block-coordinate retention, preserving every used palette state, entity, block-entity and nested payload. Pinned StructureTemplateManager runs STRUCTURE data fixing before load. Native single_pool_element placement includes entities and setsFinalizeEntities(true); after transformed position/UUID replacement and NBT entity creation, mobs receive STRUCTURE finalizeSpawn. NeoForge21.1.244 adds processor.processEntity, preserves UUID replacement and conditional finalization; native NoWater processor has no entity override. Thus raw saved minecraft:generic.* attributes, foreign attribute IDs, current Health and copied ForgeCaps are not assertions of final live stats. Constructor/config multipliers, NBT read overrides, registry resolution, data fixing and finalization retain the separately reviewed consumers. Mini/boss finalization writes actual placed spawn position, replacing stale saved source-world coordinates. Raw examples include Ancient Guardian Health170 or200/max200; Frostbitten170 or219.69998/max220; Skeletosaurus149.59997 or150/max150; Shulker Mimic150/180/200 with matching saved max; low health/native sleep/phase/texture flags remain evidence, not an additional attack. All309 entity HandItems are empty; 306 armor arrays empty, five armor stands carry ordinary iron/chainmail. No installed active-effect payload. Native item entity contains Ancient Spike Count1/Health5/PickupDelay0/Age3803/Lifespan6000; owner/age interpretation remains native loading. One annihilation bottle projectile retains Owner UUID/LeftOwner/HasBeenShot; placement replaces its own UUID, not arbitrary owner links. Seven distinct spawner payload variants request Spikebug, Chorusling, Husk, Bomber or Wither Skeleton: MaxNearby6/RequiredPlayerRange16/SpawnCount4/minDelay200/max800/range4; delays0/44/50/142, empty SpawnPotentials and simple SpawnData.entity.id. Server BaseSpawner checks player range, collision, placement/rules, nearby cap and successful additions; simple id-only spawn data selects native finalizeSpawn. No automatic all-at-once spawn follows from SpawnCount. Eighteen trapdoor BEs retain tick and animationTick0; locks/open/part come from palette, animation-running state starts false. Sixteen swinging axes retain world-coordinate scratch/ticks that active ticker recomputes before collision. Two teleport-machine BEs have old a=0 field with no custom load consumer, so active state initializes false. One anchor has palette charges0. Empty dispenser/hopper payloads install no ammunition. Three old chests contain ordinary native inventory including iron gear, SharpnessIII book and enchanted golden apple; all other container behavior follows empty inventory/loot table references. Fourteen actual loot-table IDs, twelve spawners,101 jigsaws and23 unpowered SAVE/CORNER structure blocks are retained; structure-block archive metadata is not an extra automatic placement. Foreign legacy ForgeCaps include inert status/cooldown inventories and gravity direction down/strength1; no Legendary Monsters reader makes them new effects, and the pinned current loader consumes NeoForge attachment keys rather than inventing an old ForgeCaps migration. Foreign installed mods may independently interpret their own data; no dependency effect is attributed to Legendary Monsters. Hazard/capture/entity behaviors reuse canonical contracts; resource copies do not duplicate independent mechanics.

effects.actual_behavior: Deferred registry factories below fix native entity categories, default dimensions and fire immunity, plus update/tracking settings. Native collision/range queries use effective entity dimensions; reviewed custom dimensions/scales override these defaults. fireImmune is native EntityType admission, not extra armor or potion resistance. Builder labels are retained literally and registry namespace is legendary_monsters; labels do not create separate effects. FallingCloud factories ignore type argument and create their own registered arrow types. Four blockentity factories are restricted to their exact corresponding blocks. Block properties copy the indicated pinned Vanilla block before explicit strength/noOcclusion/noCollision changes: strength(F) uses both hardness and resistance; inherited block behavior remains native. IndestructibleBlock copies Netherite material and adds pistonBLOCK, so its name alone gives no bedrock invulnerability; SomberTrapdoor copies Bedrock. Enderstone strength sharedfloat2.5. No new actor payload inferred from registries. Unregistered Cloud Bread food definition remains distinct from registered Infected Chorus Fruit.
